                                                                Can Vision-Language Models be a Good Guesser?
                                                               Exploring VLMs for Times and Location Reasoning

                                                        Gengyuan Zhang 1,2        Yurui Zhang 3 Kerui Zhang 1 Volker Tresp 1,2
                                                                                   1
                                                                                LMU Munich, Munich, Germany
                                                                    2
                                                                      Munich Center for Machine Learning, Munich, Germany
                                                                               3
                                                                                 Technical University of Munich




arXiv:2307.06166v2 [cs.CV] 29 Dec 2023
                                                                                          zhang@dbs.ifi.lmu.de



                                                                 Abstract

                                            Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are expected to be ca-
                                         pable of reasoning with commonsense knowledge as human
                                         beings. One example is that humans can reason where and
                                         when an image is taken based on their knowledge. This
                                         makes us wonder if, based on visual cues, Vision-Language
                                         Models that are pre-trained with large-scale image-text re-
                                         sources can achieve and even surpass human capability in
                                         reasoning times and location. To address this question, we
                                         propose a two-stage R ECOGNITION & R EASONING prob-
                                         ing task applied to discriminative and generative VLMs to
                                         uncover whether VLMs can recognize times and location-          Figure 1. An example image of times and location reasoning in
                                         relevant features and further reason about it. To facili-       WikiTiLo: Can you tell where and when is this picture taken?
                                         tate the studies, we introduce WikiTiLo, a well-curated im-
                                         age dataset compromising images with rich socio-cultural
                                         cues. In extensive evaluation experiments, we find that
                                         although VLMs can effectively retain times and location-            With VLMs trained on extensive knowledge corpora
                                         relevant features in visual encoders, they still fail to make   comprising multi-modal data, an intriguing question arises:
                                         perfect reasoning with context-conditioned visual features.     can VLMs reason about the implicit sociocultural back-
                                         The dataset is available at https://github.com/                 grounds associated with an image, such as its times and lo-
                                         gengyuanmax/WikiTiLo.                                           cation? Just as in the popular game ‘GeoGuesser,’ where
                                                                                                         players are tasked with locating an image based on visual
                                                                                                         cues, we contemplate whether VLMs can also exhibit a sim-
                                                                                                         ilar aptitude for being a ‘good guesser.’ This kind of com-
